Lunar Delivery Planner V2.5.39 AUTO PRODUCT DATA RECOVERY BETA

Import either a Lunar basket spreadsheet or a standard Lunar Order CSV. Standard Order CSVs are accepted directly; because Lunar Order CSVs do not contain In-Store dates, the planner automatically attempts to retrieve Lunar Product Data by the included Lunar codes before building the weekly schedule. This planner estimates the weekly delivery bundles and product costs from the In-Store dates. Your latest imported basket is saved in this browser, so you can clear the screen and later refresh it to today's date without importing again. Already-released stock is placed into the next expected weekly shipment; future books are grouped into the week of their In-Store date. This is a planning forecast, not a Lunar invoice.

This is the editable website-prep workspace. Review titles, descriptions, images and ComicRox selling prices here. Changes to a saved batch are retained while it waits for the Lunar invoice.

eBay pricing key — what do these figures mean?
Green — 5+ usable comparable listings.
Amber — only 1–4 usable comps; treat cautiously.
ComicRox £ colour — green = within 10% of market; amber = 10–20% below; red = more than 20% below; blue = more than 15% above.
Grey — not checked or no usable matches.
eBay Market £ — median of accepted active listings LOCATED IN THE UK. Overseas listings are excluded from the market benchmark, so a cheap US item with expensive delivery cannot make the UK market look artificially low. Postage is not added to UK item prices.
eBay Range £ — lowest to highest accepted item price after obvious slabs/signed/sets and statistical outliers are removed.
Comps — UK-located listings accepted as useful matches. “Seen” is how many UK eBay results were examined. If there are few UK comps, the result is amber rather than silently using overseas prices.
Match — GTIN means barcode match; Title means title/issue/variant matching was used.
Confirm this after you have checked titles, descriptions, images and prices. You can still reopen/edit the saved batch later.

Lunar Export

Exports a Shopify-ready CSV using the reviewed Lunar records. Release dates control Pre-Order / New Release / Modern classification; future titles receive the — PRE-ORDER suffix and preorder warning text. Rows without an image are allowed.
